name: Moskov
story: A warrior of the desert that embraced the darkness to seek his revenge.

skills.name: Spear of Quiescence
skills.desc: Moskov's Basic Attacks can penetrate the target and deal (+68% Total Physical Attack)- (+110% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies behind them (scales with hero level). Each Basic Attack hit reduces the cooldowns of Abyss Walker by 0.8s and Spear of Misery by 0.8s.

skills.name: Abyss Walker
skills.desc: Moskov teleports to the target location, increasing his Attack Speed to 1.15 times for 3s. Meanwhile, his Basic Attack deals (+10% Total Physical Attack) more damage to enemies behind the primary target.

skills.name: Spear of Misery
skills.desc: Moskov launches a powerful strike at the target enemy hero or Creep, dealing 300 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, knocking them back, and revealing their position for 2s. If the target collides with an enemy hero when knocked back, they'll both take 200 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and be stunned for 1.2s. If the enemy is knocked into a wall, they will also be stunned for the same duration.

skills.name: Spear of Destruction
skills.desc: After a short delay, Moskov throws the Spear of Destruction in the target direction, dealing 340 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path and to the first enemy hero hit. Upon hitting an enemy hero, the spear pierces them, dealing 10% extra Physical Damage to enemies behind them. The target and enemies hit by the piercing damage will be slowed by 50% for 1s (the slow duration scales with the spear's travel time, up to 3s). When Spear of Destruction hits the first enemy hero, it creates a shadow behind them and refreshes the cooldown of Abyss Walker. Use Again: Moskov casts Abyss Walker from the shadow's location (shares the same cooldown as the skill).
